title: k6 performance plan
description: A plan for run-perf.js. run-perf.js enforces this shape and the safety rules itself (perf-guard.js) before k6 starts; this schema documents the shape and lets editors validate it. Credentials never go in a plan: auth.sessions names where a session value comes from, never the value.

load.description: Exactly one shape: { stages } (ramping-vus), { vus, iterations } (shared-iterations, a bounded number of calls) or { vus, duration } (constant-vus).

iterations.description: Total calls shared by all VUs (at least vus).

topic.description: Short slug; names the evidence folder and files.

testType.description: ISTQB test type, named before the run.

baseUrl.description: Its host must be the host of project.qaBaseUrl in qa/qa-framework.config.json, and it must not contain "prod" (write-safety-policy.md, section 7).

goAhead.description: Policy section 6: every load run against the shared QA environment has a go-ahead that states the account or lane used.

account.description: The account or lane NAME, never its credentials.

scheme.description: cookie: Cookie header; bearer: Authorization: Bearer <value>; header: <headerName>: <value>.

sessions.description: One entry per independent session; VUs use them round-robin. Each entry is either an environment variable NAME or a gitignored file path (relative to the k6 folder), never the value.

load.description: Default load of every endpoint without its own.

exitCriteria.description: Declared before the run, never fitted to the result. Zero failed calls is always an implicit criterion.

source.description: Who agreed the criteria, or the stated assumption.

baseline.description: Tag of the baseline endpoint (in this plan, or in baselineSummary).

baselineSummary.description: Optional: a k6 summary JSON saved by an earlier run, relative to the k6 folder.

maxRegressionPct.description: Candidate p95 at most this % above the baseline p95.

minSpeedup.description: Baseline avg / candidate avg at least this.

context.description: Assumptions and caveats printed in the report.

serverMonitoring.description: What server metrics were watched and where.

outDir.description: Evidence folder, relative to the k6 folder. Default: qa/05-test-execution/performance/<date>-<topic>/.

tag.description: Stable short name; metric name and report row label.

path.description: Relative to baseUrl. Never a full URL.

bodies.description: One body per VU (round-robin), so concurrent writers each act on their own record.

query.description: POST only: declares a query with no side effect, so it is treated as a read (policy section 1).

jsonField.description: Top-level field of the JSON response that must equal jsonValue.

dataVolume.description: Record volume behind the result (data representativeness).

writeCatalogId.description: Writes only: the approved entry of the project's write catalog.

concurrentWrite.description: Writes only: authorization for more than one call (policy section 6). Valid only on approvedOn.

approvedBy.description: The write approver named in write-safety-policy.md section 0.

approvedOn.description: The day of the run it covers.

confirmation.description: Where the confirmation back to the approver and the go-ahead in reply are recorded.
